text:
Alex: quick postmortem follow-up — we saw a cross-region fanout trigger repeated LB retries on us-east -> eu-west path around 03:12Z. Root cause looks like a routing-hash skew + transient TLS SNI mismatch on fallback. Need remediation owners + timelines. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/252345 :wave:

Jamie: taking network ownership. I'll triage the route-hash config and SNI rewrite rules. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Ravi: I'll audit LB configs and cert rotation logs. I saw a spike in 502s, saving logs now.

Jamie: quick repro curl against the failing path, fyi:
```
curl -v -H "Host: api.redwood.example" https://lb-us-east-1.redwood.internal/test -I
```

Priya: I'll own the canary plan and runbook updates. Suggest we add an automated probe to detect SNI mismatch and fail fast to fallback model.

Marta: we need a release window and smoke owner for the rollback/patch.

Alex: action items (owned):
- Network triage: Jamie — finish by 2026-03-25 EOD
- LB config diff + rollback plan: Ravi — by 2026-03-26 09:00Z
- Canary tests + probe: Priya — by 2026-03-27
- Release window + smoke: Marta — secure 2026-03-28 02:00Z
- Incident recurrence tracking & postmortem update: Alex — ongoing, weekly check-ins x2

Jamie: found a routing-table mis-hash that can cause uneven fanout when a route rebalances; I have a small PR to normalize the hash function. pinging @Ravi for cert overlap check.

Ravi: cert rotation DID overlap with the routing change window — probable race condition. Drafting rollback steps and will add a pre-rotation health threshold to LB controller.

Priya: adding a scheduled probe that validates SNI across regions and a threshold alert. Also will set up a two-week cadence to watch for recurrence.

Marta: booked 2026-03-28 02:00Z slot and will own smoke signoff. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2026-03-28T02:00Z — canary -> full.

Alex: thanks everyone. Reconvene in #incidents on 2026-03-26 09:00Z for a status check. If you hit blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
